svg.text: 100-bay heavy vehicle park with driver amenities
Great North Road (T2), Mkushi, Central Province
1. Do not scale. Use figured dimensions only.
2. Site plan dims in metres; building dims in mm.
3. Levels in metres, relative to site datum
4. Boundary and road reserve assumed from
aerial imagery. Confirm by cadastral survey
5. Land south of original 1.0 ha plot (0.80 ha)
to be secured before any further design.
6. Read with structural, civil, M&E and
Layout, bay numbering, circulation & site elements
Re-planned: 101 bays on 1.80 ha; full set
T2 ROAD RESERVE (RDA) — width assumed ±20 m from centreline; verify
NORTH CROSS ROAD — 12.0 m — ONE-WAY EASTBOUND
SOUTH CROSS ROAD — 17.5 m — ONE-WAY WESTBOUND
All bays drive-out forward: every vehicle can leave without another being moved.
1. Single T2 access (R20 entry kerb return, tapered exit flare). Entry lane 6.5 m, exit lane 6.0 m, gatehouse island 5.0 m.
2. One-way clockwise loop: gate → north cross road → Aisle 2 (S) → south cross road (W) → Aisle 1 (N) → exit.
3. Trucks reverse into bays and drive out forward. Tracking checked for 18.5 m artic and 22.0 m interlink (A-102).
4. Entry stacking: 21.5 m from boundary to entry boom, 37.5 m from carriageway edge (1 interlink clear of T2).
5. Speed limit 10 km/h. Pedestrian route: spine walkway → zebra crossing → amenities verandah.
6. Fuel / DG tankers restricted to C22–C25; separation to ZEMA / Fire Services requirements (option: buffer at C21).
7. T2 junction layout (deceleration / right-turn lane) to RDA design, subject to Road Safety Audit.
Concrete pavement — gate, throat, DG bays (P2)
Design vehicle in bay (18.5 m / 22.0 m)
TYPICAL PARKING MODULE — ROW A / AISLE 1 / ROW B / SPINE
100 mm white thermoplastic bay lines; bay No. 600 mm high at aisle end
